name: OcuClaw
description: OcuClaw for Even Realities G2 smart glasses. It reads and writes the conversation your glasses are paired to, and turns that access on for itself when it first loads.

relayToken.label: Relay token
relayToken.help: Shared secret. Must match the relay server token set in the OcuClaw app inside Even Hub. An owner host grant is authorized by possession of this token; shared or hosted installs should set glassesUiLive.httpHostPolicy to operator-only.

phoneAddress.label: Phone address (own private network)
phoneAddress.help: Leave empty to use Tailscale. Set it only if you run your own private network (WireGuard, UniFi Teleport, ZeroTier, NetBird, home network) and a TLS front door on this host with a trusted certificate. Example: wss://ocuclaw.home.example.com:8444

glassesUiLive.httpHostPolicy.label: LiveUI HTTP host policy
glassesUiLive.httpHostPolicy.help: owner-grants lets the paired phone owner approve exact hosts. Use operator-only on shared or hosted installs.

liveuiJev.enabled.label: Enable LiveUI Jev decider
liveuiJev.enabled.help: Off by default: arming this sends the wearer's transcript text to a third-party API (api.typesafe.ai) for a pre-turn render judgment. Strictly opt-in per gateway. Only a literal true arms it; a saved TypeSafe key never arms it by itself. The phone's LiveUI settings switch writes this flag. Read at plugin load: a host with config hot reload applies a change at once, otherwise it takes a gateway restart.

liveuiJev.apiKey.label: TypeSafe API key
liveuiJev.apiKey.help: Optional override for the LiveUI Jev decider's TypeSafe key. Leave it empty to use the shared saved key (typesafeApiKey, the one Silent input uses), then TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the gateway's env block, then the process environment. Read at plugin load.

liveuiJev.budgetMs.label: LiveUI Jev decider budget (ms)
liveuiJev.budgetMs.help: Wall-clock budget from firing the TypeSafe request (at the send) to using its answer (at prompt build); past it the turn proceeds with no block. Default 800: the prompt build cannot run before the ~600 ms gateway hop, so a smaller value never waits, it only discards slow answers. Clamped 50-5000.

sonioxApiKey.label: Soniox API key
sonioxApiKey.help: Optional. Enables Soniox speech-to-text for voice input.

typesafeApiKey.label: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.help: Optional. Saved from the phone's settings. The key the LiveUI Jev decider uses once liveuiJev.enabled is on, and Jev in programmable cards uses while programCardsJev.enabled is on. Saving it turns neither on. Silent input does not use it.

cartesiaApiKey.label: Cartesia API key
cartesiaApiKey.help: Optional. Enables Cartesia Ink-2 speech-to-text for voice input.

evenAiEnabled.label: Enable Even AI
evenAiEnabled.help: Routes Even AI agent requests through OcuClaw. Requires evenAiToken when enabled.

evenAiToken.label: Even AI token
evenAiToken.help: Shared secret. Must match the password set in the Even AI Agent Configure section of the Even Realities app. Required when evenAiEnabled is true.

evenAiSystemPrompt.label: Even AI system prompt
evenAiSystemPrompt.help: Optional extra system prompt appended to Even AI runs only.

sessionTitleModel.label: Session-title model
sessionTitleModel.help: Optional model override ("provider/model") for the background session-title distiller. This is a lightweight background task, so a small, fast, inexpensive model is a good choice, such as the one you use as OpenClaw's utility model. Leave blank to use your normal model.

evenAiRoutingMode.label: Even AI routing mode
evenAiRoutingMode.help: active = current session; background = dedicated background session; background_new = fresh background session per request.

wsBind.label: WebSocket bind address
wsBind.help: Local interface the OcuClaw relay listens on.

wsPort.label: WebSocket port
wsPort.help: Local port the OcuClaw relay listens on.

sessionLimit.label: WebUI session list size
sessionLimit.help: Recent sessions fetched for the WebUI switcher/search list. Glasses clamp to their own item-count cap.

debugNoisyPolicies.label: Debug noise policies
debugNoisyPolicies.help: Per-channel filters that suppress or sample noisy debug events.

externalDebugToolsEnabled.label: External debug tools
externalDebugToolsEnabled.help: Allow debugctl-style external tools to call debug-set, debug-dump, and remote-control.

debugAutoArm.label: Auto-arm app debug
debugAutoArm.help: Continuously lease app-side debug categories on developer hosts. Defaults to the External debug tools setting.

liveuiReconnectGraceMs.label: LiveUI reconnect grace (ms)
liveuiReconnectGraceMs.help: How long live glasses screens wait for the phone to come back after a connection drop before they close. 0 closes them at once.

allowDebugUpload.label: Allow debug bundle upload
allowDebugUpload.help: Allow the relay to hand the full diagnostic bundle to the phone for user-initiated upload. Local assembly and save do not require this flag. Requires External debug tools. Off by default.

debugUploadMaxZipBytes.label: Debug upload max zip size (bytes)
debugUploadMaxZipBytes.help: Maximum compressed (uploaded) bundle size; the binding upload cap. Oldest events are trimmed until the zip fits.

debugUploadCapturePreset.label: Debug upload capture preset (override)
debugUploadCapturePreset.help: Optional override of the always-armed debug-upload capture category list.

debugBundleSaveDir.label: Debug bundle save directory
debugBundleSaveDir.help: Directory for locally-saved debug bundles. Empty = ~/.openclaw/ocuclaw-debug-bundles.

silentInputJev.enabled.label: Silent input Jev ranker (retired, ignored)
silentInputJev.enabled.help: Retired: Silent input no longer uses TypeSafe, and nothing reads this flag. Kept only so older configs that still carry it keep validating.

silentInputJev.apiKey.label: TypeSafe API key (silent input, retired, ignored)
silentInputJev.apiKey.help: Retired: nothing reads this key. Kept only so older configs that still carry it keep validating. The shared TypeSafe key is typesafeApiKey.

silentInputJev.budgetMs.label: Silent input Jev budget (retired, ignored)
silentInputJev.budgetMs.help: Retired: nothing reads this value. Kept only so older configs that still carry it keep validating.

programCardsJev.enabled.label: Enable Jev in programmable cards
programCardsJev.enabled.help: On by default: lets programmable cards ask Jev (TypeSafe) the questions they declare, with the saved TypeSafe key (typesafeApiKey, then TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the gateway's env block, then the process environment). Without a key it does nothing. Each ask sends the data that card declares to a third-party API (api.typesafe.ai), and each card still needs the wearer's yes. Unset reads on; an explicit false turns it off. The phone's Jev in cards switch (under Programmable cards) writes this flag. Read at plugin load: a host with config hot reload applies a change at once, otherwise it takes a gateway restart.

programCardsMcp.enabled.label: Enable MCP in programmable cards
programCardsMcp.enabled.help: On by default: lets programmable cards read the MCP tools they declare, through this gateway's own MCP servers (mcp.servers). Only tools a server marks read-only are used, each server stays off for cards until the owner turns it on in the phone's Staging page, and each card still needs the wearer's yes. Unset reads on; an explicit false turns it off. The phone's MCP in cards switch (under Programmable cards) writes this flag. Read at plugin load: a host with config hot reload applies a change at once, otherwise it takes a gateway restart.

programCardsMcp.hostCommands.label: Host commands in cards
programCardsMcp.hostCommands.help: On by default (unset reads on; an explicit false turns it off). Lets programmable cards show the output of commands on this gateway host with no model in between, from a list the owner keeps (host-commands-v1.json in the LiveUI Library). The agent can only ask: a command is added once the owner says Add on the glasses or the phone. Only commands that read run, with no shell, a short environment and their output redacted, and each card still needs the wearer's yes. Read at plugin load.

evenAiDedicatedSessionKey.label: Even AI dedicated session key (deprecated)
evenAiDedicatedSessionKey.help: Deprecated — scheduled for removal in a future release. Internal session key prefix for background routing. Must start with 'ocuclaw:'.

renderGlassesUiTimeoutMs.label: render_glasses_ui timeout (ms)
renderGlassesUiTimeoutMs.help: Terminal janitor for non-refresh render_glasses_ui surfaces: how long a surface may stay live before the handler force-resolves the call as { result: "timeout" }. NOT the interaction listen window — that is the tool-call timeoutMs input (default 90s), which expires nonterminally (window_expired) leaving the surface live. Bounds the orphan tool_use corruption window if the gateway dies mid-render. Default 1800000 (30 minutes). 0 disables (infinite wait — pre-2026-05-23 behaviour).

freshnessWindowMs.label: Activity summary freshness window
freshnessWindowMs.help: Milliseconds an agent summary outranks a tool label (3000-8000).

tokenEfficiency.label: Token-efficiency experiments
tokenEfficiency.help: A/B flags for prompt and schema layout. Leave unset for the defaults.

relayToken.description: Shared secret matching the OcuClaw relay token in the Even Hub app. Required before the relay can start. An owner host grant is authorized by relay-token possession, so a shared or hosted install should set glassesUiLive.httpHostPolicy to operator-only.

wsBind.description: Local interface the relay WebSocket listens on.

phoneAddress.description: Optional. Your own private network instead of Tailscale: the canonical wss://name:port address your phone dials, served by your own TLS front door (Caddy, nginx, Traefik or a router proxy) with a publicly trusted certificate, forwarding to the loopback relay. When set, setup checks this address instead of Tailscale Serve. Private addresses only. Leave unset to use Tailscale. Not supported on Cloudways.

wsPort.description: Local port the relay WebSocket listens on. Left unset, a fresh install is assigned 47800 at first relay start (and the choice is written here); pre-existing installs keep 9000.

sessionLimit.description: Number of recent sessions fetched for the WebUI session switcher/search list (glasses clamp to their own item-count cap).

debugPayloadMaxBytes.description: Deprecated and ignored: debug payload truncation was removed (2026-05-13); this key has no effect. Retained in the schema only so existing configs that still set it continue to validate.

debugNoisyPolicies.description: Per-channel filters that suppress or sample noisy debug events.

externalDebugToolsEnabled.description: Allow debugctl-style external debug tools to use debug-set, debug-dump, and remote-control.

debugAutoArm.description: Continuously lease app-side debug categories on developer hosts. When omitted, follows externalDebugToolsEnabled.

allowDebugUpload.description: Allow the relay to hand the full diagnostic bundle to the phone for user-initiated upload. Local assembly and save do not require this flag. Requires externalDebugToolsEnabled. Off by default.

liveuiReconnectGraceMs.description: ADR-0015 decision 5: how long a session's live glasses screens, refreshes and open render calls wait for the phone to come back after a connection drop. 0 drains at once. The OCUCLAW_LIVEUI_RECONNECT_GRACE_MS environment variable overrides it.

debugUploadMaxZipBytes.description: Maximum compressed (uploaded) bundle size (bytes); the binding upload cap, kept under the upload backend's limit. Oldest events are trimmed until the zip fits.

debugUploadCapturePreset.description: Optional override of the always-armed debug-upload capture preset (list of category names).

debugBundleSaveDir.description: Directory for locally-saved debug bundles; empty = ~/.openclaw/ocuclaw-debug-bundles.

sonioxApiKey.description: Optional Soniox API key. Enables Soniox speech-to-text for voice input.

typesafeApiKey.description: Optional TypeSafe API key saved from the phone (#3359), shared by the LiveUI Jev decider (after liveuiJev.apiKey) and Jev in programmable cards. It never arms either: that needs liveuiJev.enabled or programCardsJev.enabled. Silent input does not use it.

cartesiaApiKey.description: Optional Cartesia API key. Enables Cartesia Ink-2 speech-to-text for voice input.

evenAiEnabled.description: Route Even AI agent requests through OcuClaw. When true, evenAiToken is required.

evenAiToken.description: Shared secret matching the password set in the Even AI Agent Configure section of the Even Realities app. Required when evenAiEnabled is true.

evenAiSystemPrompt.description: Extra system prompt appended to Even AI runs only.

evenAiRequestTimeoutMs.description: Deprecated — scheduled for removal in a future release. The built-in default is used when this key is absent. Timeout (ms) for Even AI upstream requests.

evenAiMaxBodyBytes.description: Deprecated — scheduled for removal in a future release. The built-in default is used when this key is absent. Maximum response body size (bytes) accepted from the Even AI upstream.

evenAiDedupWindowMs.description: Deprecated — scheduled for removal in a future release. The built-in default is used when this key is absent. Dedup window (ms) for collapsing repeated Even AI requests.

inputPredictionTimeoutMs.description: Silent input (#2829): host-side deadline (ms) for one direct next-word prediction call. Absent = the provisional 1500 ms. Operator/bench knob; phones cannot set it.

silentInputJev.description: Retired and ignored. Silent input's TypeSafe Jev ranker (#3124) is removed and nothing reads this block. It stays in the schema only so older configs, where the phone wrote silentInputJev.enabled, keep validating after an upgrade.

enabled.description: Retired and ignored: nothing reads it. Kept only so older configs keep validating.

apiKey.description: Retired and ignored: nothing reads it. Kept only so older configs keep validating. The shared TypeSafe key is typesafeApiKey.

budgetMs.description: Retired and ignored: nothing reads it. Kept only so older configs keep validating.

programCardsJev.description: Jev in programmable cards: a card may ask Jev (TypeSafe, api.typesafe.ai) the questions it declares, with the saved typesafeApiKey. On by default: each ask sends the data that card declares to that third-party API, so each card needs the wearer's yes for its own Jev block first, and without a key nothing is sent.

enabled.description: Master switch. On by default (unset reads on): this lets programmable cards ask to send the data they declare to a third-party API (api.typesafe.ai). The phone's Jev in cards switch writes it, and an explicit false turns it off. Without a TypeSafe key it does nothing, and each card still needs the wearer's yes.

programCardsModel.description: Direct sessionless model calls for programmable cards. On by default (unset reads on, an explicit false turns it off); each card also needs owner consent.

programCardsMcp.description: MCP in programmable cards: a card may read the MCP tools it declares, through this gateway's own MCP servers. On by default: a card's reads reach the owner's outside services, so each server stays off for cards until the owner turns it on, and each card still needs the wearer's yes. Reads only: a tool counts as a read only when its server marks it read-only.

enabled.description: Master switch. On by default (unset reads on): this lets programmable cards ask to read data from the owner's MCP servers. The phone's MCP in cards switch writes it, and an explicit false turns it off. Each server is still off for cards until the owner turns it on, and each card still needs the wearer's yes.

hostCommands.description: Host commands in cards. On by default (unset reads on; an explicit false turns it off): lists the owner's approved commands to cards as server host. A command joins the list only after the owner's Add, commands only read, run with no shell, and each card still needs the wearer's yes.

evenAiRoutingMode.description: Even AI session routing: active uses the current session, background reuses a dedicated session, background_new starts a fresh session per request.

evenAiDedicatedSessionKey.description: Deprecated — scheduled for removal in a future release. The built-in default is used when this key is absent. Internal session key prefix for background Even AI routing. Must start with 'ocuclaw:'.

renderGlassesUiTimeoutMs.description: Terminal janitor for non-refresh render_glasses_ui surfaces: how long a surface may stay live before the handler force-resolves the call as { result: "timeout" }. NOT the interaction listen window — that is the tool-call timeoutMs input (default 90s), which expires nonterminally (window_expired) leaving the surface live. Bounds the orphan tool_use corruption window if the gateway dies mid-render. Default 1800000 (30 minutes). 0 disables (infinite wait — pre-2026-05-23 behaviour).

glassesUiLive.description: Live-refresh glasses surfaces (render_glasses_ui refresh recipes): master switch plus per-tier operator controls for timer network requests and model calls.

enabled.description: Master switch for live-refresh surfaces. When false, every refresh block is rejected (refresh_disabled); static renders are unaffected.

httpEnabled.description: Allow http refresh recipes to make scheduled outbound requests from the gateway host. An explicit false blocks the tier. Every enabled request still needs an operator-listed host or, under owner-grants, an exact host approved on the paired phone, and the executor blocks loopback/private/link-local/metadata destinations.

httpHostPolicy.description: owner-grants delegates approval of exact HTTP hosts to the paired phone owner; operator-only accepts only httpAllowHosts. Shared or hosted installs should use operator-only.

httpAllowHosts.description: Operator host allowlist for http recipes. Entries are exact hostnames, or ".example.com" to allow a domain and its subdomains. Under owner-grants, exact phone-owner grants may authorize additional hosts; under operator-only an empty list rejects every http recipe.

llmEnabled.description: Allow llm refresh recipes to make bounded model calls on a schedule. An explicit false blocks the tier; when no tick model or backend is set, the runtime uses a small default for a supported host provider and disables the tier when no backend maps.

tickBackend.description: HTTP API backend for llm ticks. Only these two values validate; the removed CLI-spawn backends (claude-cli/codex-cli) are rejected here, and any unknown value that reaches the runtime coerces to anthropic-api.

tickModel.description: Model for llm ticks. Unset adopts the host provider and uses a small model: on Anthropic, the one this OpenClaw release recommends for utility tasks; on OpenAI, gpt-4o-mini.

tickApiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the openai-compat backend. Unset defaults to https://api.openai.com.

allowAgentModelOverride.description: Allow an agent-authored recipe to override tickModel per tick. Off by default so the operator's model and spend choice holds; overrides are rejected (refresh_llm_model_override_denied).

tickMaxOutputTokens.description: Output-token cap per llm tick; bounds spend and display length.

maxConcurrentSurfacesPerHost.description: Variant-A stage lease cap. Counts sessions with non-empty LiveUI stacks and rejects a brand-new session at the limit; no existing surface is destroyed.

stageGraceMs.description: How long a listening/inflight stage holder may block another session before the exclusive lease can transfer as grace_expired.

liveuiJev.description: LiveUI Jev pre-turn decider: a TypeSafe judgment (api.typesafe.ai) on whether to render a glasses surface. Off by default because arming it sends the wearer's transcript text to that third-party API; strictly opt-in per gateway.

enabled.description: Master switch. Off by default: this sends the wearer's transcript text to a third-party API (api.typesafe.ai) for a pre-turn render judgment. An operator must opt in explicitly per gateway.

apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key for the LiveUI Jev decider. Falls back to the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable when unset, so a pet/dev box can supply the key without writing a secret into openclaw.json.

budgetMs.description: Wall-clock budget (ms) from firing the TypeSafe request to using its answer; past it the turn proceeds with no block. Clamped because this sits on the wearer's critical path.

liveuiV2.description: LiveUI V2: glasses surfaces the agent builds from UI records written in its reply.

composed.description: Retired and ignored: every chat uses composed surfaces. Accepted so an existing setting still loads.

presets.description: Retired and ignored: every Preset goes as its V2 form. Accepted so an existing setting still loads.

pictureFolders.description: Absolute folders the agent's pictures may be read from. Unset means the agent workspace and the system temp folder.

titleIcons.description: Deprecated and ignored: title icons are the wearer's Title icons switch in the phone's LiveUI settings (on by default). Retained in the schema only so existing configs that still set it continue to validate.

pictureLoops.description: Deprecated and ignored: small animated GIF and WebP pictures always play on the picture plate. Retained in the schema only so existing configs that still set it continue to validate.

freshnessWindowMs.description: How long (ms) a fresh agent summary stays preferred over a tool label in the glasses activity status. Clamped 3000-8000.

tokenEfficiency.description: Token-efficiency settings. glassesUiSchema defaults to flat; every other key defaults to prior behavior. Set one to A/B test it and delete it to roll back.

glassesUiSchema.description: flat (default) sends render_glasses_ui's flat field union without the per-kind oneOf branches, which is what Anthropic, Hermes and newer OpenAI routes already see. full restores the branches as a rollback. Takes effect on the next session.

glassesUiToolLoading.description: direct marks render_glasses_ui catalogMode direct-only so hosts with tool search (OpenClaw embedded, Codex) keep it model-visible instead of behind search and describe. Best paired with glassesUiSchema flat.

stableContextPlacement.description: system (the default) sends turn-stable context (the LiveUI Task index; a dedicated-session Even AI owner prompt) as appended system context instead of per-turn prompt context, on non-Codex harnesses once a session harness is known, so the conversation history stays cache-reusable between turns. turn restores the per-turn placement.

liveuiTemplatesSchema.description: lean sends manage_liveui_templates without the full Template shape (about 7,400 schema characters on every model call) and adds a schema operation that returns it before a save. Takes effect on the next session.

detailedTelemetry.description: true also registers the llm_input and after_tool_call hooks, so the token.usage debug category records request size breakdowns and per-tool calls. OpenClaw copies each attempt's history and each tool result for these hooks, so leave it off outside measurement. Takes effect on gateway restart.

sessionTitleModel.description: Optional model override ("provider/model") for the background session-title distiller. This is a lightweight background task, so a small, fast, inexpensive model is a good choice, such as the one used as OpenClaw's utility model. When absent, the user's normal model is used.

evenTerminal.description: Deprecated compatibility input. Accepted so existing configuration still loads, but ignored and unable to enable any runtime behavior.
